dana: FYI planning to unpin runtime 2.14 for 'safelist-lite' tonight 01:00 UTC. Purpose: fix allocation leak affecting warmup. Canary strategy: 5% (10m) -> 30% (20m) -> 100%. Change window 01:00-02:30 UTC. Any blockers?

lee: Quick compat note 023 SDKs: SDK 3.7.2 required. I'll run SDK smoke at 00:30 UTC.

sam: Rollback triggers: worker OOM, p95 latency > baseline*2 for 5m, or >2% client errors for 10m. Also watch safelist.output_truncated metric.

dana: Add embedding drift check: safelist-embeds-50, abort if mean cosine delta > 0.015.

deploybot: scheduled unpin request by @dana for 3591012345. To cancel: /deploybot cancel 3591012345.

lee: SDK smoke (00:32) - sdk-3.7.2 and 3.6 fallback pass on canary. KV warmup OK.

docs: Drafted release blurb: "Runtime 2.14.x: fixes for background allocation during KV warmups; no API changes." PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302

eng-sre: Night coverage confirmed. Pager on for alerts referenced. I'll add temp watch on safelist.kv_warmup.failures >0 for 5m.

sam: tagging: if any prompt-set regressions on safelist-regress-quick, immediate rollback.

dana: OK all green so far. Will flip canary at 01:00 and monitor. Post if you want me to hold at 5% for longer. :thumbsup:
